arxiv-2105-11378.title: Adiabatic transport in one-dimensional systems with a single defect
arxiv-2105-11378.creator: Kazuaki Takasan, Masaki Oshikawa, Haruki Watanabe
arxiv-2105-11378.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Kazuaki Takasan, Masaki Oshikawa, Haruki Watanabe. The adiabatic transport properties of U(1) invariant systems are determined by the dependence of the ground state energy on the twisted boundary condition. We examine a one-dimensional tight-binding model in the presence of a single defect and find that the ground state energy of the model shows a universal dependence on the twist angle that can be fully characterized by the transmission coefficient of the scattering by the defect.
